cases.situation: My coworker Sam told me privately over DM that she's been diagnosed with MS and will have a lot of appointments. Same team, not super close; she runs our Thursday client check-ins.
cases.reply: Thank you for trusting me with that, Sam. I'm really sorry. If it helps, I can take the Thursday client check-ins whenever you're at an appointment, just send me the dates. It stays with me.
cases.note: Workplace version: warmth, one practical offer, and privacy. No questions about the diagnosis.

cases.situation: 我妈刚打电话说体检查出甲状腺结节，要做穿刺，她语气挺害怕的。我在外地工作，想挂了电话再给她发条微信。
cases.reply: 妈，谢谢您第一时间告诉我。我已经请好假了，下周三回家，做穿刺那天我陪您一起去。有什么事我们一起面对。爱您。
cases.note: 对方害怕时就稳一点，给一个具体的行动，不要追问病情细节。

cases.situation: My friend told me she has breast cancer and I blurted out that my aunt died of it. I'd already offered to bring dinner on Thursday. I feel awful and want to fix it.
cases.reply: I've been thinking about what I said about my aunt, and it wasn't what you needed to hear. I'm sorry. I'm here, I'll follow your lead, and I'm still bringing dinner on Thursday unless you tell me otherwise.
cases.note: One line of ownership, then back to her. A long apology makes her comfort you.

cases.situation: My friend Hannah has long COVID and just cancelled our dinner for the third time. She texted 'I'm so sorry, I feel like the worst friend, my body just won't cooperate.' I'm not upset, I want her to know that.
cases.reply: You're not the worst friend, not even close. I'm sorry your body's making everything this hard. No apologising for cancelling, ever. I'll keep inviting you, and if a sofa and a takeaway at yours sounds more doable, I'm free Saturday. No need to reply tonight.
cases.note: Release her from the guilt first, then offer a lower-energy version of the plan instead of just rescheduling the same one.

cases.situation: Mi amigo Javi me escribió por WhatsApp: 'Me han encontrado un tumor, casi seguro benigno, me operan el 14 de octubre. Lo bueno es que ya tengo excusa para no ir a la cena de empresa.' Quiero contestarle bien.
cases.reply: Solo tú podrías anunciar una operación con un chiste sobre la cena de empresa. Siento mucho que estés pasando por esto, y me apunto al humor negro todo lo que haga falta. También me apunto a llevarte al hospital el 14 y a recogerte después, solo dime la hora. No hace falta que contestes esta noche.
cases.note: Si lo cuenta con humor, acompaña el tono, pero sin quitarle peso: reconoce la noticia, ofrece algo concreto con fecha y libéralo de contestar.

cases.situation: 我带的组员小何私聊我，说确诊了中度抑郁，医生建议休息两周，想从下周一开始请假。她不想让组里其他人知道原因。
cases.reply: 谢谢你愿意告诉我，这不容易。你安心休息，假我批了，10月5号到16号。你手上的工作我安排别人接，你把在跟的事列个简单清单发我就行，不用写得很细。组里我只说你请假，不会提原因。想聊或者需要什么随时找我，不回消息也完全没关系。
cases.note: 上级回应下属的健康消息：先接住，再把假期、交接、保密一次说清，最后给她不用回复的自由。

cases.situation: My brother-in-law Dan told the family in August he has stage 3 colon cancer and started chemo. Everyone texted that first week, now it's gone quiet. He hasn't answered my last two messages.
cases.reply: Thinking of you today, Dan. No need to reply. I'm dropping a lasagne on your porch Saturday around noon, and I won't knock unless you text me to.
cases.note: Weeks in, silence is usually exhaustion: keep sending short no-reply messages with one concrete thing, and never ask why he's gone quiet.

cases.situation: My friend Priya had a mastectomy two weeks ago. I've texted a few times and she just replied: 'Thank you, I love you, but I need to go quiet for a while and not talk about it.' I don't want to disappear, but I want to respect it.
cases.reply: Of course, Priya. Thank you for telling me what you need. I'll go quiet, and I'm still right here. Unless you tell me otherwise, I'll send one short hello in early November, with no reply needed then either. Love you.
cases.note: When they ask for space, honour it in a few words and name when you'll check back, so quiet never turns into disappearing.

cases.situation: My friend Kelly posted on Facebook that her son Noah (6) was just diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and they're in the children's hospital until Friday learning to manage it. Our kids are in the same class, and her older daughter Ava is in 4th grade at the same school. I want to message her.
cases.reply: Kelly, I just saw your post about Noah. I'm so sorry, what a week for all of you. I'll take Ava to and from school for the rest of the week, so that's one thing off your list; just tell me if you'd rather I didn't. Otherwise no need to reply.
cases.note: When it's a child's diagnosis, the parent is the one you support: a practical offer that happens by default, and no questions about the medical side.

cases.situation: 好朋友小敏的老公上周五突然中风，现在还在ICU，她一个人在医院守着，两个孩子暂时托给婆婆。她今天在群里简单说了一句情况，我想私信她。
cases.reply: 小敏，刚看到你说的，太突然了，心疼你。谢谢你告诉我们。这周六我可以去你婆婆家接两个孩子出来玩半天，让老人歇一歇，你同意我就直接跟婆婆约时间。不用回我，等你有空再说。
cases.note: 照顾者同样需要被看见：不问病情细节，给一个具体的帮忙，并免去她回复的负担。

cases.situation: 我跟我爸五六年没怎么联系了，他再婚后关系一直很淡。今天他突然发微信说查出肺癌，下个月在成都做手术，就这一句。我不知道怎么回，但不想装没看见。
cases.reply: 爸，谢谢你告诉我。听到这个消息我很难过。这周六晚上8点左右我给你打个电话，不想接也没关系，这条也不用回。手术日子定了告诉我一声，我想过去陪你一两天。
cases.note: 关系疏远时不用补上这些年，也不追问病情；先接住消息，给一个小而具体的动作，主动权留给他。

cases.situation: My manager, Karen, emailed our team of eight that she's been diagnosed with breast cancer, starts treatment next week and will be on reduced hours through December. I usually back her up on the Monday team meeting and vendor calls. I want to reply to her privately, not reply-all.
cases.reply: Karen, thank you for telling us so openly, and I'm really sorry you're facing this. On the work side, I'm happy to run the Monday team meeting and cover the vendor calls while you're on reduced hours, just say the word. No need to reply to this. Thinking of you.
cases.note: Upward, keep it short: warmth, one practical offer within your role, no questions about the diagnosis, and nothing that needs an answer.

cases.situation: My close friend Owen texted that he's checking into a 28-day residential program for his drinking on Monday. He said only his sister and I know, and asked me not to tell anyone. We've been friends since school, and he lives alone with his dog, Rufus.
cases.reply: Owen, thank you for telling me. That took guts, and I'm really proud of you. It stays with me. I can have Rufus for the 28 days, or pop round to walk him and grab your post, whichever helps; just tell me which. No need to reply tonight.
cases.note: Treat it like any health news: thanks, privacy said out loud, one practical offer, and no questions about how bad it got.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance web designer. Ruth, a client of three years who runs a small pottery studio, emailed that she's been diagnosed with a heart condition, has surgery on Oct 14, and wants to pause her website project for 'a month or two'.
cases.reply: Ruth, thank you for letting me know, and I'm so sorry you're dealing with this. Please don't give the website another thought: I'll pause it exactly where it is, nothing is due from you, and there's no invoice until we pick it back up. Whenever you feel ready, one line from you is all it takes and we'll carry on from there. No need to reply to this. I'll be thinking of you on the 14th.
cases.note: From a supplier or freelancer: warmth, lift every work obligation in one go, and no questions about the diagnosis.

cases.situation: My friend Sofia texted that she lost the pregnancy at 11 weeks yesterday. Only a few people knew she was pregnant. She said she doesn't want to talk about it yet.
cases.reply: Sofia, I'm so sorry. Thank you for telling me, and it stays with me. You don't need to talk about it with me until you want to, if ever. I'm leaving dinner for you on the doorstep on Thursday evening, no knock. No need to reply.
cases.note: No questions, no 'at least it was early', nothing about trying again; follow her lead on whether it gets talked about.

cases.situation: 好友小雯去年做了乳腺癌手术和化疗，今天复查结果出来一切正常。她发微信说：“结果挺好的，可我还是天天担心复发，是不是很没出息？”
cases.reply: 小雯，太好了，真替你高兴！一点都不没出息，经历了这一年，会担心再正常不过，不用逼自己马上轻松起来。想说担心的时候随时找我，不用装开心。这周六下午一起去走走？不想出门也完全没关系，不用急着回。
cases.note: 好消息里夹着害怕时，两样都接住；别说“要乐观”“肯定没事”，那会让她的担心变成一种失败。

cases.situation: 大学室友小雅骑车摔断了腿，住院一周，今天在朋友圈发了张病床照片，说“要躺一阵了”。她一个人住，养了只猫，我有她家备用钥匙。想发微信给她，又怕打扰她休息。
cases.reply: 小雅，刚看到你住院了，心疼你。你不叫我，我就不去医院打扰你休息。你住院这几天，猫我每天下班过去喂，用我手上那把备用钥匙，你只管养伤。不用回我。
cases.note: 朋友住院：不擅自探望，不问是怎么摔的，主动接下一件具体的事，并免除她回复的负担。

cases.situation: Graham, 72, was my late dad's best friend and like an uncle to me. He emailed that his cancer has spread, he's stopped treatment and is having palliative care at home, and he'd welcome visitors 'while I'm still decent company'. I still have the photos of him and Dad on their Lake District trips.
cases.reply: Graham, thank you for telling me, and for telling me so plainly. I'm so sorry. I'd love to come and see you. Could I come on Saturday 10 October in the afternoon, and bring the photos of you and Dad in the Lake District? If that day's no good or you're tired, just say, and one line back is plenty.
cases.note: When someone says they're dying and wants company, take them at their word: no questions about how long, a specific visit, and let him set the pace.

cases.situation: 我在德国工作。我哥在家族群里说，爸爸上周确诊了早期阿尔茨海默病，这几个月都是他一个人带爸去看医生。他说得很平静，但我知道他扛得很累。爸不在这个群里。我12月有两周假可以回国，也可以从这周六开始每周六晚上跟爸视频。
cases.reply: 哥，谢谢你告诉我，也谢谢你这几个月一直带爸看医生，你一个人扛了这么多，辛苦了。我12月有两周假，回国那两周爸的事都交给我，你好好歇一歇。从这周六开始，我每周六晚上给爸打视频，陪他聊聊天。这条不用急着回。
cases.note: 消息来自照顾病人的家人时，也要接住照顾者本人：谢谢他、分担一件具体的事，不追问病情细节。

cases.situation: 女儿在英国读研，今天微信告诉我她确诊了1型糖尿病，住了三天院，已经学会自己打胰岛素。她语气挺平静，说“别担心，先别告诉奶奶”，还说我不用飞过去。我特别想马上订机票。
cases.reply: 闺女，谢谢你第一时间告诉妈妈，这几天一个人在医院，辛苦你了。你说不用过去，妈妈听你的；哪天想让我过去陪几天，一句话我就订票。奶奶那边我不说，等你自己想说的时候再说。这周六晚上咱们视频聊聊，不想聊病的事就随便聊，这条不用急着回。
cases.note: 父母最想追问和叮嘱，先忍住：跟着她平静的语气，尊重她的安排和隐私，给一个具体的联系时间。

cases.situation: Over coffee today my friend Marcus told me he's HIV positive. He was diagnosed in August, he's on treatment and doing well, and he said he was nervous to tell me. We go climbing together most Thursdays. I want to text him tonight.
cases.reply: Marcus, thank you for telling me today. I know it wasn't easy, and I'm really glad you did. It stays with me. Nothing changes on my side, and I'll see you at the wall on Thursday as usual. No need to reply.
cases.note: With a stigmatised diagnosis, normality is the specific offer: thanks, privacy, the usual plan, and no questions about how.

cases.situation: 大学で講師をしている高橋です。ゼミ生の佐藤さんから、先週てんかんと診断されたので10月8日（木）の中間発表を休ませてほしいとメールが来ました。発表は10月22日（木）に回せますし、ゼミの他の学生に理由を言うつもりはありません。
cases.reply:
佐藤さん
知らせてくれてありがとう。大変な一週間でしたね。中間発表は10月22日（木）に移しておきます。ゼミのみんなには日程の変更とだけ伝えて、理由は言いません。ほかにも授業のことで調整が必要になったら、一言くれれば対応します。この返信は不要です。
高橋
cases.note: 教員から学生へ：病状は聞かず、日程・プライバシー・返信不要の三つを一度に伝える。

cases.situation: I'm Sarah. My neighbour Mrs Albright, 81, told me over the fence this morning that she's been diagnosed with macular degeneration and isn't allowed to drive any more. She sounded brisk about it but I could tell she was upset. She does her shopping on Tuesdays, and I drive to the supermarket every Tuesday morning anyway. I want to put a note through her door.
cases.reply: Dear Mrs Albright, thank you for telling me this morning. I'm so sorry, that's a lot to take in, and losing the car on top of it. I drive to the supermarket every Tuesday morning anyway, so I'd be glad to take you along with me, or pick up your list if you'd rather. Just knock, or leave the list in my porch. No need to reply. Sarah
cases.note: Her sight is failing, so write the note in large, clear print, and fit the offer into a routine you already have so it's easy to accept.

cases.situation: Our WhatsApp group of eight uni friends had been quiet for months. Last night Tom posted that he's been diagnosed with testicular cancer and has surgery on Tuesday 6 October. People are replying with questions about the stage and stories about relatives; I want to reply in the group, and I live ten minutes from him.
cases.reply: Tom, thank you for telling us, and I'm so sorry. You don't owe any of us details; share what you want, when you want. I'm ten minutes away, so I can drive you to the hospital on Tuesday or bring dinner round that week, whichever is more use. Just message me privately, and no need to reply here.
cases.note: In a group thread, model the reply you'd want the others to give: no questions, one concrete offer, and the logistics moved to a private message.

cases.situation: My friend Leah, 34, texted that she tested positive for the BRCA1 gene and her doctors have raised a preventive double mastectomy. She asked me straight out: 'What would you do?' I don't think it's my place to tell her, and we usually walk together on Saturday mornings.
cases.reply: Leah, thank you for telling me, that's a huge thing to carry. Honestly, I don't think what I'd do should weigh in on this; it's your body and your call, and whatever you decide, I'm with you. If talking it through would help, let's make Saturday's walk a long one. And if you'd like company at any of the appointments, just send me the dates.
cases.note: When they ask for your opinion on a medical choice, offer a place to think out loud instead of a verdict; their doctors are the ones to weigh the options with.

cases.situation: 男朋友阿哲在深圳工作，我在北京。他今晚发微信说确诊了强直性脊柱炎，是慢性病，要长期吃药，还说“以后可能会拖累你，你要想清楚”。我没想过要走。这周五下班我可以飞过去陪他过周末。
cases.reply: 阿哲，谢谢你告诉我，我知道说出这些不容易。我没有想走，这一点不用想清楚，我已经很清楚了。这周五下班我飞过去陪你过周末。想聊病的事我们就聊，不想聊就一起吃饭、看电影。这条不用急着回。
cases.note: 对方担心拖累你时，先正面回应这一句，再给一个具体的陪伴；不追问病情，也不给治疗建议。

cases.situation: Ines and I have been in the same online book club on Discord for four years; she's in Lisbon, I'm in Leeds, and we've never met. She just messaged me privately that she's been diagnosed with lupus and will step back from hosting our Sunday reading sessions for a while. I can host the Sunday sessions through November.
cases.reply: Ines, thank you for telling me, and I'm so sorry you're dealing with this. Please don't give the Sunday sessions another thought: I'll host them through November, and the chair is yours whenever you want it back. Drop in, just listen, or skip them entirely, whatever suits you. No need to reply.
cases.note: An online friend you've never met: the offer that fits is the shared space you actually have, held open without pressure.

cases.situation: My friend Claire and I haven't spoken since an argument in May about her wedding plans. Today she texted that she has Hodgkin lymphoma, starts chemo on 12 October, and 'didn't want you to hear it from someone else'. I want to put the argument aside, and I live ten minutes from the hospital where she's being treated.
cases.reply: Claire, thank you for telling me yourself, it means a lot. I'm so sorry. Whatever happened in May doesn't matter to me right now, and we don't need to talk about it. I live ten minutes from the hospital, so on the 12th or any treatment day I can drive you there or meet you afterwards, whichever helps. No need to reply.
cases.note: After a falling-out, the news comes first: don't relitigate or apologise at length, and let one concrete offer show you mean it.

cases.situation: My close friend Mia texted that their third IVF round has failed and the clinic told her and her wife that more rounds are unlikely to work. I'm 22 weeks pregnant and she knows; I don't want my pregnancy to make this harder for her. We usually walk our dogs together on Sunday mornings.
cases.reply: Mia, I'm so sorry. Thank you for telling me. I'm here for all of this, and you never have to manage my pregnancy around it; if you need some distance from me for a while, that's okay, and I'll still be here. I can do our Sunday dog walk as usual, or just take your dog out for you, whichever helps. No need to reply.
cases.note: Names the pregnancy once, gives her permission to step back, then puts the focus back on her.

cases.situation: My little brother Ollie, 19, is at uni about two hours from me. He just texted that he spent last week in a psychiatric unit, has been diagnosed with bipolar disorder, is out now and on medication, and asked me not to tell our parents yet. He sounded flat rather than panicked, and I'm free to drive down on Saturday 10 October.
cases.reply: Ollie, thank you for telling me. I'm really sorry you've been through that, and I'm glad you're out and being looked after. I won't say anything to Mum and Dad; that's yours to share when you're ready. Could I drive down on Saturday the 10th and take you out for lunch? No need to reply tonight, I'm here.
cases.note: Keep his confidence about the diagnosis; if he ever says he's thinking of harming himself, call emergency services or a crisis line with him.

cases.situation: 好朋友阿宁今天告诉我，她确诊了神经性厌食症，在医院门诊治疗，让我先别告诉别人。我们以前几乎每周都约火锅。她最近很喜欢看展，这周日下午市美术馆有个她一直想看的插画展。
cases.reply: 阿宁，谢谢你愿意告诉我，我知道说出来不容易。这件事我不会跟任何人说。这周日下午市美术馆那个插画展，我陪你去看好不好？想聊就聊，不想聊我们就安安静静看展。这条不用急着回。
cases.note: 不评论身材和饮食，邀约也换成不围着吃饭的事；如果她提到伤害自己的念头，陪她联系医生，紧急时拨打急救电话。
